12 reactions | First Philippine Industrial Park (FPIP) welcomed the Philippines–Jiangxi Business Delegation, as part of a series of investment and business engagements organized in coordination with the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA). 

During the visit, the FPIP team welcomed the delegation for a developer briefing and ecozone site tour, sharing an overview of FPIP’s developments, infrastructure, facilities, and established industrial ecosystem. 

The delegation brought together business leaders from various industries, including technology, electronics, intelligent biotechnology, automotive services, international logistics, optical technology, metal manufacturing, hospitality, and real estate. 

The visit supported broader efforts to strengthen economic and trade cooperation between the Philippines and Jiangxi Province, China, while exploring opportunities at FPIP and providing a platform for businesses to explore opportunities for growth and build connections within the country's industrial ecosystem.

As the Philippines strengthens its economic ties with international business communities, FPIP continues to connect prospective investors with the capabilities of the Philippine manufacturing sector.
